“Work smart, not hard.”

It’s good advice but incomplete.

Early in your career, hard work often teaches you what books and courses can’t:

• Which tasks actually create value
• Where your time gets wasted
• What mistakes cost you the most
• What can be systemized or delegated
• Where your strengths really are

Over time, that experience compounds.

You stop simply working harder.

You start working with clarity, leverage, and intention.

The goal was never to avoid hard work.

The goal is to become smart enough that your hard work creates disproportionate results.

What’s one lesson you learned the hard way that now helps you work smarter?

Some people don’t hate you because you’re doing something wrong.

And definitely don’t lie just to make your story sound impressive.

Build the life. Get the results. Let the results do the talking.

The quote “No player is better than the whole team together” («Ningún jugador es tan bueno como todos juntos») spoken by Luis de la Fuente serves as a masterclass in horizontal leadership and modern sports psychology. In an era often dominated by individual stardom, de la Fuente’s approach prioritizes the collective unit, psychological safety, and shared ownership, proving that a unified team will consistently outperform a collection of isolated talents.

Horizontal leadership discards traditional top-down authoritarianism in favor of collaboration, trust, and shared responsibility. Rather than building a team around one or two franchise superstars, de la Fuente created a culture where every individual’s contribution is vital:

Distributed Ownership: By emphasizing that the group transcends any single ego, de la Fuente empowers every squad member—from teenage prodigies like Lamine Yamal and Pau Cubarsí to key substitutes like Ferran Torres—to feel equally responsible for the team's destiny.

Psychological Safety: Players perform with freedom when they know the system is built on collective resilience rather than individual blame.

Seamless Continuity: Having coached many of these players through Spain's youth ranks (U19, U21, and the Olympic team), de la Fuente built years of trust and shared tactical language long before taking over the senior national team.
This philosophy is backed by an extraordinary, historically unprecedented era of success across every level of international football:

FIFA World Cup 2026 Champions: Conquered world football with a 1-0 extra-time win over Argentina, relying on depth and a sub-106th-minute winner by Ferran Torres.

UEFA Euro 2024 Champions: Built an unselfish, high-tempo attacking machine that dismantled Europe's top sides.
UEFA Nations League 2023 Champions & 2025 Finalists: Established Spain's winning mentality in senior knockout tournaments.
Youth Titles (U19, U21, Olympic Gold/Silver): Cultivated a long-term pipeline tailored specifically to a group-first mindset.
Luis de la Fuente has redefined high-performance management.

A Proud Ceylon Tea Moment – A Journey Comes Full Circle 🇱🇰🇸🇦

My sincere gratitude to His Excellency the Ambassador of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka Omer Lebbe Ameer Ajwad  honouring occasion, and to the incredible Tamimi Markets team for their trust, partnership and warm hospitality in launching our Ceylon Tea Gardens (CTG) range of Bogawantalawa Tea in the Kingdom.

Saudi Arabia, The country I proudly call my second home after living nearly a decade there, made this occasion even more memorable. Entering Tamimi brought back wonderful memories of my Almarai - المراعي  days, wearing the Almarai T-shirt alongside the sales and merchandising teams before Ramadan, filling shelves from chillers to ensure stores were ready for customers. Looking back, I could never have imagined that one day I would return to launch a Sri Lankan tea brand on those very same shelves. Life truly comes full circle.

We are especially proud to have chosen Tamimi Markets  as the exclusive retail home for Ceylon Tea Gardens in Saudi Arabia, making Tamimi the destination of choice for authentic premium Ceylon Tea in the Kingdom.

To consumers across Saudi Arabia, I warmly invite you to discover Ceylon Tea Gardens ; where Circle of Care meets exceptional taste, a range of whole leaf, tea bags and flavour and infusions, Every pack is freshness locked in to deliver an authentic Ceylon tea experience while making a meaningful difference and contribution to the Lanka Mother and Child Foundation (established in 2005), helping uplift thousands of single mothers and children through healthcare, education, support for children with special needs, and community development.

Thank you the Tamimi Markets Team Husnee Thassim  Arun Zachariah  @bruce, and our valued consumers for making this milestone possible.

Special Thanks and deep appreciation to my dynamic regional marketing head Anne Ranasinghe and the Team Mohamed Najilan  @sanduni. for the market entry and launch event.  

#tamimi
#tea
#ceylon

🇸🇦 لحظة فخر واعتزاز 🇱🇰🇸🇦

أتقدم بخالص الشكر إلى سعادة سفير جمهورية سريلانكا على تشريفه هذه المناسبة، وإلى فريق أسواق التميمي على ثقتهم وشراكتهم في إطلاق مجموعة Ceylon Tea Gardens (CTG) في المملكة.

كانت العودة إلى المملكة العربية السعودية، التي أعتز بأنها وطني الثاني بعد ما يقارب عقدًا من الزمن، لحظة مميزة أعادت إليّ ذكريات أيامي مع المراعي، عندما كنت أرتدي قميص المراعي وأعمل مع فرق المبيعات والتسويق التجاري قبل شهر رمضان في تجهيز الأرفف والثلاجات. واليوم، أعود لأطلق علامة شاي سريلانكية على الأرفف نفسها… إنها حقًا رحلة تكتمل فصولها.

ونحن فخورون بمنح أسواق التميمي الإطلاق الحصري لعلامة Ceylon Tea Gardens، لتكون الوجهة الأولى للشاي السيلاني الفاخر في المملكة، مع المزيد من المنتجات والعلامات التجارية الجديدة التي ستصل قريبًا.

ندعو جميع المستهلكين إلى تجربة Ceylon Tea Gardens، حيث يجتمع Circle of Care مع المذاق السيلاني الأصيل. كما يساهم كل شراء في دعم 
شكرًا لكل من ساهم في إنجاح هذا الإنجاز، ونتطلع إلى المزيد من النجاحات بين سريلانكا والمملكة العربية السعودية

Sri Lanka’s Premium Bogawantalawa Tea Launched at Tamimi Markets in Saudi Arabia

Ambassador of Sri Lanka to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Ameer Ajwad, launched Sri Lanka’s renowned Bogawantalawa Tea, one of the country’s finest premium Ceylon Tea brands, at Tamimi Markets, the leading hypermarket chain in Saudi Arabia, on 9 July 2026 in Riyadh. Ceylon Tea Gardens of Bogawantalawa Tea Ceylon supplies Bogawantalawa Tea exclusively to the Tamimi hypermarket chain in the Kingdom.

Addressing the gathering, Ambassador Ameer Ajwad pointed out that Saudi Arabia is one of the most important export destinations for Ceylon Tea and that the launch of Bogawantalawa Tea marked yet another significant milestone in expanding the presence of premium Ceylon Tea in the Saudi market. While expressing appreciation to Tamimi Markets for providing an excellent platform to introduce premium Sri Lankan tea to Saudi consumers, the Ambassador proposed the establishment of a dedicated “Sri Lanka Corner” for premium Sri Lankan products in Tamimi Markets. He also highlighted the steady growth of Sri Lankan exports to Saudi Arabia in recent years and emphasized the importance of further expanding Sri Lanka’s export basket in the Kingdom.

Co-Chairman of Bogawantalawa Tea Ceylon, Mr. Lalith Kumar Ambani, introduced the Ceylon Tea Gardens brand, stating that Bogawantalawa Tea is internationally renowned for its exceptional quality, distinctive flavour, freshness, and heritage spanning over a century. He noted that the introduction of Bogawantalawa Tea under the Ceylon Tea Gardens brand enriches Tamimi Markets’ premium tea portfolio by providing consumers across Saudi Arabia with access to the authentic taste of premium Ceylon Tea.

Director/Chief Executive Officer of Bogawantalawa Tea Ceylon, Mr. Almas Marikkar, highlighted the company’s diverse product range and its commitment to corporate social responsibility through the welfare and development of estate communities, while Ms. Anne Ranasinghe, Marketing Manager – Middle East and Asia of Bogawantalawa Tea Ceylon, presented the story behind Bogawantalawa Tea.

During the launch, Mr. Ayham Nasser, Regional Senior Manager, Mr. Bruce Bostwick, Business Development Director, and Mr. Husnee Thasim, Category Manager of Tamimi Markets, participated and reaffirmed Tamimi Markets’ commitment to offering its customers the finest international brands.

First Secretary (Commerce) of the Embassy of Sri Lanka in Riyadh, Ms. Tashma Vithanawasam, Assistant Manager Product Innovation and Infusions of Bogawantalawa Tea Ceylon, Mr. Kabeer Tharick and Tamimi Markets Area Managers, Mr. Riyad Salamih and Mr. Yassir Ghalib, were also present during the occasion.

Embassy of Sri Lanka
Riyadh
13 July 2026

Your proposal of a dedicated "Sri Lanka Corner" is one we would be proud to help bring to life. Grateful to our Co-Chairman, Mr Lalith Ambani, and to the entire Bogawantalawa Tea and Tamimi markets team who made this moment happen.
